description: Update a project, portfolio or goal by id.

comment.description: Comment to post together with the update (a "project status update")

fields.description: Fields to update, e.g. {"summary": "New name", "entityStatus": "at_risk", "parentEntity": {"primary": "portfolio-id", "secondary": []}} or with set/add commands like {"teamUsers": {"add": ["user2"]}}

links.description: Entity links to add together with the update

name: update_entity
